Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, there is a distinct and sudden drop in the value of E (mm) around index 600. The data fluctuates between roughly -2.5 and -5.0 for most of the series, but at x ≈ 600, it drops sharply to around -10.0 and stays low until about x ≈ 670 where it jumps back up. This entire segment represents an anomaly relative to the rest of the series.

The points of anomalies are:
[600, 601, 602, 603, 604, 605, 606, 607, 608, 609, 610, 611, 612, 613, 614, 615, 616, 617, 618, 619, 620, 621, 622, 623, 624, 625, 626, 627, 628, 629, 630, 631, 632, 633, 634, 635, 636, 637, 638, 639, 640, 641, 642, 643, 644, 645, 646, 647, 648, 649, 650, 651, 652, 653, 654, 655, 656, 657, 658, 659, 660, 661, 662, 663, 664, 665, 666, 667, 668]
